energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Built-in processor energy counters and strict 970 MB RAM limits on open coding benchmarks.

claims.statement: Generating fresh text from scratch for already-solved problems wastes electricity and invites avoidable mistakes.
An energy-ordered cascade checks microjoule lookup tables and exact verifiers first, waking large models only on genuine novelty.
Every accepted answer passes deterministic checks and crystallizes downward into a fast, reusable lookup skill.
Headline outcome: 90.6% Open Coding · 0.00% Broken Commits · 970 MB RAM (Built-in processor energy counters and strict 970 MB RAM limits on open coding benchmarks.)
